item.description:
Koegaki 1.13.2

  • This release is for the Mac. Windows stays on 1.13.1.
  • On the Mac, with Restore my previous clipboard after inserting on, a dictation that no app took still waits on the clipboard for Cmd V, but it no longer takes the place of what you had copied. While the app stays open, Koegaki's next paste that lands puts back what you had copied before, or anything copied since. As before, Koegaki never puts back a password from a password manager, or a clipboard that is too large or that it cannot read in full, and leaves the new dictation there instead.
  • On the Mac, when a dictation ends, the on-screen pill now goes away and the stop sound plays as its text is pasted, about a quarter of a second sooner than before.
